metadata.title: Noisering
metadata.author: Manga Artist
metadata.synopsis:
"They" are real... One month has passed since the Great Shizuoka Earthquake. Marine research organization JANSTEC has been conducting observations of submarine faults in order to uncover the cause of the massive quake. Yadorigi, a blind young man working as a sonarman, assists in navigating the manned deep-sea submersible when they make a discovery...

(Source: MANGA Plus)
